gossip-grill.tagline: SoCal's premier women's & LGBTQ+ bar and restaurant
gossip-grill.description: A Hillcrest women's/LGBTQ+ bar and restaurant open 7 days a week, serving American comfort food with a patio bar and dance floor since 2009.

eq.hours: Varies by event; typically Mon-Sat until 2am
eq.tagline: Hillcrest club for electronic, house & themed nights
eq.description: A 21+ Hillcrest nightclub in the former Merrow space with a Funktion-One sound system, LED ceiling and DJ-driven house, techno, bass and themed events.

the-brass-rail.tagline: San Diego's oldest LGBTQ+ bar, established 1934
the-brass-rail.description: A historic Hillcrest LGBTQ+ bar and nightclub operating since 1934, with a Main Stage hosting drag, Latin nights and DJ events.

negociant-winery.tagline: Hillcrest urban winery with small-lot wines & live music
negociant-winery.description: A boutique urban winery and tasting room in Hillcrest crafting small-lot wines on-site, with flights, bottle sales, live jazz, trivia and community events.

rich-s.hours: Wed 10pm-2am, Thu-Fri 9pm-2am, Sat 9pm-4am, Sun 9pm-2am, closed Mon-Tue
rich-s.tagline: San Diego's largest LGBTQ+ dance nightclub
rich-s.description: A longtime Hillcrest LGBTQ+ nightclub with two rooms, each with its own bar, DJ and dance floor, plus VIP booths and outdoor patios.

first-unitarian-universalist-church-of-s.hours: Sunday worship services; office hours vary
first-unitarian-universalist-church-of-s.tagline: Welcoming Unitarian Universalist congregation in Hillcrest
first-unitarian-universalist-church-of-s.description: A Unitarian Universalist congregation rooted in San Diego since 1873, with a Hillcrest campus offering worship, community programs and performance/event spaces.

cork-stem.tagline: Hillcrest wine bar and flower shop under one roof
cork-stem.description: A combined wine bar, flower shop and event space in Hillcrest offering wine, beer and light bites alongside a build-your-own flower bar, workshops and event florals.

shift-pilates.tagline: Boutique Hillcrest Pilates studio for mindful movement
shift-pilates.description: A boutique Pilates studio in Hillcrest blending classical and contemporary Pilates with somatic principles, offering group classes, privates and teacher training.

all-saints-episcopal-church.description: An Anglo-Catholic Episcopal church in Hillcrest offering Sunday Low Mass (8am) and Solemn Mass (10:30am) plus weekday services, Sunday School and adult formation.

reset.hours: Mon-Thu 5:30am-7pm, Fri 5:30am-6pm, Sat 9-11:30am, Sun closed (24/7 open gym for members)
reset.tagline: Black-owned CrossFit and wellness studio in Hillcrest
reset.description: A Black-owned, veteran-founded fitness and wellness studio (formerly CrossFit Hillcrest) blending strength and conditioning with yoga, breathwork, sauna and cold plunge, plus 24/7 open gym.

r-place-bar-eatery.hours: Mon 3pm-12am, Tue closed, Wed-Thu 3pm-1am, Fri 3pm-2am, Sat 11am-2am, Sun 10am-12am
r-place-bar-eatery.tagline: LGBTQ+ and Latino-owned Hillcrest sports bar
r-place-bar-eatery.description: Hillcrest's LGBTQ+ and Latino-owned sports bar and eatery (opened 2025), serving Mexican-American bar fare, cocktails and draft beer with NFL Sunday Ticket, arcade games and a heated patio.

breakfast-bitch.description: A cheeky, Black-owned all-day brunch concept known for loaded croissants, pancakes and mimosas.

urban-mo-s-bar-grill.tagline: Iconic Hillcrest gay bar, grill and dance venue
urban-mo-s-bar-grill.description: San Diego's landmark LGBTQ bar and grill in Hillcrest, serving burgers and cocktails for 30+ years with drag shows, themed dance nights and a lively patio.

alibi.tagline: Cash-only Hillcrest dive bar with pool and patio
alibi.description: A longstanding cash-only dive bar in Hillcrest featuring pool tables, video games, a large outdoor patio and free pool on Sundays.

hillcrest-brewing-company.tagline: The world's first LGBT brewery and pizzeria
hillcrest-brewing-company.description: Billed as the world's first out-and-proud LGBT brewery (opened 2012), serving handcrafted beers alongside stone-oven thin-crust pizzas, with growlers and kegs to go.

artreach-san-diego.tagline: Youth visual-arts education nonprofit in Hillcrest
artreach-san-diego.description: A women-owned 501(c)(3) nonprofit providing visual arts education and collaborative mural programs to TK-12 youth across San Diego County, with a community art studio in Hillcrest.
